title: Double Drip 10K Spearmint Menthol Prefilled Vape Pods + Refill
description: Compatible with the Double Drip 10K Prefilled Pod Kit, this Pod & Refill Pack offers a straightforward way to replenish your favourite flavour. Each pack includes a 2ml prefilled pod and a 10ml refill bottle of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, designed to deliver up to 10,000 puffs per kit (depending on usage) with consistently smooth performance. Spearmint Menthol combines the crisp, clean taste of cooling Menthol with a subtly sweet Spearmint finish. It’s a refreshing, palate-cleansing flavour that stays bright and balanced all day long. To keep vaping without interruption, just insert a new pod and refill bottle and let the auto-refill system keep your device topped up—mess-free and maintenance-free.
